'''Vorin's Lightsaber''' was wielded by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vorin]] in [[3667 BBY]]. Vorin swung the [[Color/Legends|green]] blade of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], but was ultimately unsuccessful and Vorin was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
